title: Field rules, version 1
description: A POS Studio theme's field rules (Retail POS Theme, table field_rules), as a shop or a partner declares them in Desk, the REST API or an import. Checked at save by business_logic/pos_fields.py validate_field_rules; what the schema cannot see (that a shown field exists and is Data, Select, Int or Check; that a sale attribute is active and not required; at most three more Item and three more Customer fields) is checked there too; and a field asked for at customer add (show on customer_create) is one the shop or an app added, Data, Select, Int or Date, at most three. Page: docs/extending/fields.md.

field_rules.description: The rules. A theme with none draws every screen as it ships.

rule.description: One rule: on this screen, do this to this field. One action per screen and field; a relabel or show may repeat per language.

surface.description: The till screen, or receipt_preview: the receipt (screen, paper and offline slip), which takes show only, or totals: the online basket's totals words, which take relabel only.

field.description: A field the screen names (hide, relabel, require), an Item or Customer field (show; an Item field on receipt_preview), a sale attribute's name (sale_details), or a money figure: price, discount, amount (relabel) and list_price (show) on cart_line; discount, charges, delivery, tax, grand_total (relabel) on totals.

label.description: The shop's word (relabel) or an extra line's heading (show), shown verbatim. A money figure's label carries no digit, no % and no currency sign (checked at save).

language.description: Blank for everyone, or the language this label is for.

sequence.description: The order of extra lines; lower first.

show_limit.description: At most this many MORE fields of each DocType a theme may show, counted once however many screens show them.

input_limit.description: At most this many of the shop's own Customer fields a theme may ask for at customer add and edit (show on customer_create), counted apart from the shown fields.
